applications.title: Site Plan and Amended Plat Review and Approval - Lib’s Grill at the Station

fields.description: The applicant has submitted two items for planning commission review and consideration: • A site plan for the incoming restaurant at the train station building located at 7618 Main St. • An amended plat to allow for the entire structure and proposed additions to remain on a single lot. This staff report will cover both topics, as they are closely related but they should be voted on as individual items.
